extraction_notes: Electrical characteristics are specified at TA = +25 degC unless otherwise stated; Note 7 specifies pulsed measurement with pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.

The hFE table publishes minimum values at five collector currents and a maximum of 300 at IC = 10 mA; the scalar hFE entries preserve the minimum values and do not convert the guaranteed bounds into typical values.

VCE(sat) values are maximum bounds. VBE(sat) is 0.65 V minimum and 0.85 V maximum at IC = 10 mA, IB = 1 mA, while only a 0.95 V maximum is published at IC = 50 mA, IB = 5 mA; the schema stores one scalar per point, so the maximum bound is retained.
Typical curves on p. 4 were digitized only for the +25 degC hFE curve, the IC/IB = 10 saturation-voltage curves, and the Cibo and Cobo capacitance curves; axes and SI units are preserved.
The datasheet has no tabulated VBE(on) row and no output-characteristics IC-versus-VCE figure, so VBE(on) and Early voltage VAF are not extractable from this source.
omission_reason: VBE(on) and VAF are omitted because the datasheet provides neither a VBE(on) electrical-characteristics row nor an output-characteristics IC-versus-VCE figure; the schema has no dedicated VBE(on) field.
